rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out (Samsung white-bg stills); 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no Samsung/Galaxy logos (text names only). No medical claims on screen: only Samsung's feature names; never show sleep apnea as a diagnosis. '$199.99' always with pill 'Black Friday'. The '87' heart score is Samsung's own example (label 'example').
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the features; blush for THE CATCH; mint for SPEC
assets: assets_sources.md (A–F official Samsung press images 3000–7087 px; G small inset only)
new_objects: sleepMoon (crescent moon with Zz and a row of rising colour dots for overnight readings; reuse for any sleep/overnight-tracking story) — add to render/kit/OBJECTS.md. Reuse: ecg, calendar, questionStamp, watchOutline, downloadBar, counter, gauge, colourDots, zoneBar, bars, priceTag, worldMap, crossMark, appTile, toggle, scoreTable, speechBubble, slash, pill.

scenes.image: A (Watch8 silver) cut out centred 80% width, slow push-in
scenes.object: ecg pulse line draws across the watch face, heart icon beats
scenes.note: frame 1 = poster A: watch + '6 FEATURES' pill peeking

scenes.anchor: just landed on last year's watch.
scenes.object: calendar flips 2026 → 2025 under the watch, pill 'last year's'
watchOutline traces the case; label 'Galaxy Watch8 · 2025' (text only, no Samsung logo drawn)

scenes.anchor: One UI nine Watch gives it six Watch nine features.
scenes.object: downloadBar fills 0→100% 'One UI 9 Watch' arrow from Watch9 to Watch8; counter '6' pops
gauge ring fills to 87 'Heart Health Score' (Samsung's own example score, label 'example')
sleepMoon NEW: crescent moon + 5 colourDots rising one by one labelled HR · temp · SpO2 · … (only HR, skin temp, blood oxygen named; others blank dots)
zoneBar slides to 'balanced'; bars grow for 'Fitness Index'

scenes.anchor: smarter sleep coaching, upgraded sleep apnea.
scenes.object: sleepMoon with Zz; calendar marks '3 nights / 2 weeks'; small pill 'back to Watch4'

scenes.anchor: And this week? It's from two hundred dollars.
scenes.object: priceTag swings in, rolls '$299.99' → strike → '$199.99'; pill 'Black Friday · 40 mm'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. Features vary by region.
scenes.object: worldMap with some regions dimmed + crossMark; pill 'Samsung: may vary'

scenes.anchor: You'll need app updates for some, too.
scenes.object: appTile 'Samsung Health' with downloadBar; toggle flips

scenes.anchor: By our score? Seventy-one out of a hundred. It's a spec.
scenes.object: scoreTable 25/25 · 12/20 · 8/15 · 7.5/15 · 8/15 · 10/10 → total counter '71/100'; k snaps upright

scenes.anchor: Grab it if you want new health tricks without Watch nine money.
scenes.image: A + F side by side, F slides out

scenes.anchor: Would you still buy the Watch nine?
scenes.object: questionStamp '?' + speechBubble 'Watch9?'; logo end card 'SPEC SCORE 71'
